source_labels.text: For each factual claim, identify the supplied source field or mark it unknown. Do not invent evidence to complete an answer.

as_of_dates.text: Distinguish the observation timestamp from the report date. State explicitly when evidence is old or unavailable.

counterfactual.text: Evaluate the reasoning using evidence available at decision time. A positive later return alone does not validate that reasoning.

explicit_change.text: When your assessment changes, identify the previous assessment and the new evidence explaining the change.

rule_origin.text: Distinguish an owner's explicit rule from the decision-maker's current preference. Do not attribute an invented limit to the charter.
